'''Zodiac Clothing Company Ltd.''' (ZCCL) is a manufacturer of men's [[clothing]] that owns the Zodiac, Zod! and z3 brands. The company produces men's apparel and accessories for Indian and international markets.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Zachariah |first1=Reeba |title=Zodiac To Merge With Mayfair |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/specials/zodiac-to-merge-with-mayfair-100083101034_1.html |access-date=17 May 2024 |work=Business Standard |date=31 August 2000}}</ref> It was started with the name of ‘House of Zodiac’ by M. Y. Noorani in 1954 as a necktie manufacturer. ZCCL was incorporated as a [[private limited company]] in 1984.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Bombay Stock Exchange - Zodiac|url=https://www.bseindia.com/download/Research_Report/Report/521163/2011-12/ZodiacClothing.pdf}}</ref> It became a deemed public limited company in December 1993 and went public in January 1994.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Zodiac Clothing Company Ltd. |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/zodiac-cloth-co-3930/information/company-history |access-date=2021-12-28}}</ref><ref name="economictimes.indiatimes.com">{{Cite web|title=Zodiac Clothing Company History {{!}} Zodiac Clothing Company Information|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/zodiac-clothing-company-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-6849.cms|access-date=2021-08-11|website=The Economic Times}}</ref>

As of 2018, Zodiac Clothing Company Ltd. has been following a company-owned model for its retail chain of 121 stores, with more than 2,100 direct on-roll employees and 1,500 independent retailers.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Zodiac Clothing Company Ltd. Annual Report 2017-18|url=https://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/521163/5211630318.pdf|access-date=2021-10-17|archive-date=2021-10-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211018011334/https://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/521163/5211630318.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|author=|title=ZCCL.BO - Zodiac Clothing Company Ltd. Profile|url=https://www.reuters.comundefined/|access-date=2021-08-11|website=www.reuters.comundefined|language=en}}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

== Mergers and acquisitions ==
[[File:Express Mall, Chennai. 0357(F).jpg|alt=A Zodiac Outlet at Express Mall, Chennai, India|thumb|A Zodiac outlet at [[Express Avenue|Express Mall]], [[Chennai]]]]
[[File:A Zodiac Outlet at Amanora Park, Pune, India.jpg|thumb|Zodiac store in [[Amanora Park Town|Amanora Park]], [[Pune]]]]
In 1992, Zodiac Textiles & Apparels Export Pvt. Ltd. (ZTAEPL), Multiplex Packaging Pvt. Ltd. (MPPL), and Bangalore-based Knitwear Pvt. Ltd. (BKPL) amalgamated with ZCCL. In 2004, ZCCL acquired a Dubai-based shirt manufacturing company for close to INR 25 crore.<ref name="economictimes.indiatimes.com" />
== Marketing ==
In 1960, Ulka Kolkata, an advertising agency launched “The Zodiac Man” campaign for the marketing of ZODIAC's shirt and tie business.<ref name="Livemint">{{Cite web|last=Livemint|date=2017-08-21|title=70 years of Indian advertising|url=https://www.livemint.com/Consumer/sRChazyrh4GcIwCsDuGquO/70-years-of-Indian-advertising.html|access-date=2021-08-11|website=mint|language=en}}</ref> Dhanji Rana, the creative director of the agency, became the face of the marketing material design for the campaign. The campaign found considerable success in India, strongly placing ZODIAC in the men's formal and casual wear segments.<ref name="Livemint"/> 

== Brands ==
Zodiac Clothing Company retails its products through three brands: ZODIAC (men's formal wear), and ZOD! Club Wear and z3 (relaxed casual wear).<ref name=":0" />

=== ZODIAC ===
Zodiac or ZODIAC brand is ZCCL's primary market face. ZCCL markets and sells formal shirts, trousers, and ties for men. The brand's main target audience is men over the age of 35.<ref name=":1">{{Cite news|last=Iyer|first=Byravee|date=2009-03-10|title=Zodiac: Designs on the youth|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/management/zodiac-designs-on-the-youth-109031000036_1.html|access-date=2021-08-11}}</ref> Zodiac is among the first formal ready-to-wear brands in India.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Gulati|first=Gurbir Singh|date=2019-09-18|title=Formal Shirts Market Analysis: Current trends and future mapping|url=https://www.indiaretailing.com/2019/09/18/fashion/formal-shirts-market-analysis-current-trends-and-future-mapping/|access-date=2021-08-11|website=Indiaretailing.com|language=en-US|archive-date=2021-08-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210811113813/https://www.indiaretailing.com/2019/09/18/fashion/formal-shirts-market-analysis-current-trends-and-future-mapping/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

=== ZOD! ===
[[File:ZodiacStore.png|thumb|A Zodiac retail store]]
Launched in 2002,<ref name="Keller 2011">{{Cite book|last1=Keller|first1=Kevin Lane|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=cofhZbwwFuYC&dq=when+was+zod+club+wear+launched&pg=PA443|title=Strategic Brand Management: Building, Measuring, and Managing Brand Equity|last2=Parameswaran|first2=M. G.|last3=Jacob|first3=Isaac|date=2011|publisher=Pearson|isbn=978-81-317-5689-8|language=en}}</ref> ZOD! primarily sells casual men's shirts and party wear targeted toward young adults.<ref name="Parameswaran">{{Cite book|last=Parameswaran|first=M. G.|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=b8r4ScFXRu4C&dq=when+was+zod+club+wear+launched&pg=PA69|title=FCB Ulka Brand Building Advertising: Concepts and Cases|publisher=Tata McGraw-Hill Education|isbn=978-1-259-00698-2|language=en}}</ref> The brand's descriptive indicator was chosen as “Club Wear” targeting active party goers, as well as nightclub and disco enthusiasts.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Parameswaran|first=M. G.|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=b8r4ScFXRu4C&dq=when+was+zod+club+wear+launched&pg=PA69|title=FCB Ulka Brand Building Advertising: Concepts and Cases|publisher=Tata McGraw-Hill Education|isbn=978-1-259-00698-2|language=en}}</ref>

The brand was strategically placed in the segment to narrow it down from the broader classification of “casual wear”, due to the growing popularity of [[Nightclub|nightclubs]] during the time.<ref name="Keller 2011"/> The brand was launched with the slogan, “ZOD! - Are you game?”.<ref name="Parameswaran"/>

=== z3 ===
Launched in 2008, z3 is ZCCL's third brand,<ref name="Keller 2011"/> positioned as a youth-centered, casual wear brand.<ref name=":1" /> z3 includes shirts, braided belts, and socks, as well as pre-washed cloths made in Egyptian cotton with a "Trademark Vintage Wash".<ref name="Keller 2011"/>
